title: TimeoutError in tls.handshake when signing in
body:
ENVIRONMENT:

Lattice version 3.0.6; operating system Debian 12; server region ap-south-1.

STEPS:

To reproduce:
- Start by signing in.
- Upgrade from the prvious release and keep the old settings.
- Wait for the failure and read the log.

EXPECTED:

As on every earlier run, signing in should just complete.

ACTUAL:

Sinnce upgrading, every attempt fails here. It began right after upgrading to this release; nothing
else changed.

FREQUENCY:

Reproduces every time.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:45 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:122 in on_login
lattice/auth/flow.py:61 in start
lattice/net/tls.py:161 in handshake
TimeoutError: handshake timed out after 30s (host=ap-south-1)
